**Severity:** error · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
`.bind` with a spread first argument is not resumable: pass the bound `this` as its own first argument (`f.bind(self, ...args)`)
```

```text
`.bind` with a spread first argument may not resume: if the callee is a function Rivet compiled, pass the bound `this` as its own first argument (`f.bind(self, ...args)`); an object with its own `bind` is fine
```

## How to fix

Write the bound `this` as the first argument; later arguments may still be spread (`f.bind(null, ...args)`).

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { signal } from "@rivetjs/reactivity";
export function A() {
  const n = signal(0);
  const add = (by: number) => n.set(n() + by);
  const args: [null, number] = [null, 2];
  const go = add.bind(...args);
  return <b onClick={() => go()}>{n()}</b>;
}
```

```tsx prefer
import { signal } from "@rivetjs/reactivity";
export function A() {
  const n = signal(0);
  const add = (by: number) => n.set(n() + by);
  const rest: [number] = [2];
  const go = add.bind(null, ...rest);
  return <b onClick={() => go()}>{n()}</b>;
}
```

## When it is reported

Resume mode (Function Bridge T10): a captured `const g = f.bind(…)` resumes as a bound function (`_rBound`). An error when the callee is provably a function (declared in the component or module, or an import); a warning otherwise (an object with its own `bind` is legal; the render-time "not serializable" error stays the ground truth).
